title: Polaroid
description: Run a live source through an old printed-photo look: a faded, sepia, instant or cold grade with lifted blacks and a warm vignette, an optional white instant-film border with the fat bottom lip, and a static layer of physical damage — hair-thin scratches, dust specks, greasy smudges and blooming water stains. The wear is generated from the sketch seed so every instance is scuffed differently and stays put over the moving image. Film tone, age and each damage type are live. Ages the camera, a dropped photo or clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
